description: This file implements memory-mapped register access functions for the B53 network switch driver, including read/write operations for various data widths, probe and remove functions for platform device management, and driver registration.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from the specified register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from the specified register and page, handling big-endian if needed.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from the specified register and page, handling big-endian if needed.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value from the specified register and page, combining multiple reads.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from the specified register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the specified register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to the specified register and page, handling big-endian if needed.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to the specified register and page, handling big-endian if needed.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value to the specified register and page, splitting into multiple writes.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to the specified register and page.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_probe(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Probes and initializes the platform device with B53 mmap driver.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_remove(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Removes the B53 mmap driver from the platform device.
